# GitHub Copilot Instructions

**Note**: The main Copilot instructions are maintained at the workspace level.

See: `../../.github/copilot-instructions.md`

This project uses shared instructions from the workspace root to ensure consistency across all WoW addon projects (AscensionVanity, FloAspectBar, FloTotemBar).

**File Locations:**
- Workspace Instructions: `d:\Repos\World of Warcraft\.github\copilot-instructions.md`
- WoW Chatmode: `d:\Repos\World of Warcraft\.github\chatmodes\wow-addon-development.chatmode.md`
- Project Patterns: `d:\Repos\World of Warcraft\.github\instructions\wow-addon-development.instructions.md`
